backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the e-commerce backend, defining types and state for products, orders, users, site settings, and WhatsApp/Stripe configuration, with mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three Razorpay-related features (device detection utility, desktop/mobile checkout configuration, and responsive modal styling) to their implementation files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, hooks, components, styles, and config for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic e-commerce app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, sidebar, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow app, loading Playfair Display and Lato fonts from Google Fonts and the Razorpay checkout script, then mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with customer routes (home, shop, product detail, cart, orders, payment) and protected admin routes (dashboard, products, orders, settings, users), wrapped with QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and CartProvider.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: Section component that presents the Ayurveda philosophy with scroll-triggered slide-in animations for left/right columns, displaying the three doshas and a link to the shop.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Route guard component that verifies the authenticated user has admin privileges via the canister actor before rendering children, showing loading, denied, error, or timeout states otherwise.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile overlay) containing navigation links, branding, and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: Admin UI widget that simulates AI image generation by mapping a text prompt to a curated Unsplash botanical image, with a preview and a button to apply the selected image URL.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Modal dialog for viewing full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and updating the fulfillment status via a dropdown with optimistic UI and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: Modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, status, specifications, image upload, and AI image generation.
frontend/src/components/admin/StatusBadg: Renders a styled badge for a given ProductStatus enum value, mapping each status to a label and color class.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: Read-only modal dialog that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: Component file for an Ayurvedic hero animation, content truncated but likely renders decorative animated botanical or particle visuals for the homepage hero section.
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Renders a section showcasing six product benefits (e.g., 100% Natural, Cruelty-Free) as animated cards with icons, using IntersectionObserver for scroll-triggered fade-in animations.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer using a Sheet component that displays cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button that navigates to the /cart page.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Fetches and displays featured products in a responsive grid with skeleton loading states, filtering out non-visible products and linking to the full shop page.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button with pulse animation and tooltip that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat, using a backend-configured number with a hardcoded fallback.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details, styled with a forest/cream color scheme.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a Ken Burns background image, layered gradient overlays, and staggered entrance animations displaying the brand name, tagline, and CTA buttons.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer component that renders nav links (Home, Shop, Orders) and an auth button (Login/Logout), visible only on small screens.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop nav links, cart icon with item count badge, mobile hamburger menu triggering MobileNavDrawer, and logout/login actions using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product card with image, status badges, add-to-cart, and buy-now (Razorpay checkout) functionality; hides notVisible products and handles purchase flow with order creation.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that seeds the backend with sample products on mount if no products exist yet.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Renders an animated grid of customer testimonial cards with star ratings, quotes, product tags, and intersection-observer-based fade-in animations.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: In-memory React context for cart state (backed by Product types from the backend) with add, remove, update, and clear operations plus cart open/close state.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: Session-storage-persisted React context for cart state using plain product data (string IDs), providing add, remove, update, clear, and cart-open toggle functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing login/logout state via AuthClient and exposing identity, login status, and helper flags to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend data fetching and mutations, covering admin status, user profiles, products, orders, site settings, and payment configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that opens a Razorpay payment checkout with device-aware payment method configuration (mobile vs. desktop), handling order creation and post-payment navigation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind, imports Google Fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for both a customer-facing Ayurvedic storefront palette and a clean admin panel palette, with light and dark mode variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
Admin dashboard page displaying summary stats (revenue, orders, products, users) with bar and pie charts for revenue trends and fulfillment status, plus a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that handles Internet Identity authentication, checks or bootstraps admin status via the backend actor, and redirects to the admin products page on success.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page with sortable, searchable order cards that display customer details and allow updating fulfillment status via a dropdown.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin products page showing a filterable product catalog with status stats, and supports adding, editing, and deleting products via a modal form and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store name, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with live/test key validation and save actions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page that fetches and displays all registered users in a searchable table, with filtering by name/principal and a click-to-open detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Cart page component that displays cart items, collects and validates a checkout shipping form, and initiates Razorpay payment processing to create an order on success.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page with a shipping details form that collects user info and initiates a Stripe payment session, redirecting to Stripe's hosted checkout URL on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes the landing experience with a hero section, seed products, featured products, benefits, testimonials, and an About Ayurveda section.
frontend/src/pages/Orders.tsx: Orders page that fetches and displays the authenticated user's order history with order cards showing status badges, product details, and formatted prices.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static payment failure page shown after an unsuccessful payment, offering buttons to retry via the cart or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that invalidates the orders query cache on mount and presents navigation options to view orders or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that displays a single product's info with quantity selection, add-to-cart, and buy-now (Razorpay) functionality, handling various product statuses.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop listing page with search, category, and status filters that render a filtered grid of ProductCard components fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/utils/deviceDetection.ts: Exports `isMobileDevice()` which detects mobile/tablet devices using user-agent pattern matching and a screen width threshold of 768px.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides `formatINR` for Indian Rupee currency formatting and `formatDate` for converting nanosecond timestamps to human-readable Indian locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Defines a `sampleProducts` array of five Ayurvedic product fixtures (face packs, powders) with prices, images, stock, and specifications for seeding the backend.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom Ayurvedic brand color palette, admin-specific CSS variable tokens, custom fonts, shadows, and keyframe animations including Ken Burns effect.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the Nature Glow Ayurvedic e-commerce app's version, architectural notes, existing features, and a pending feature request to improve Razorpay checkout UX across mobile and desktop.
